sources.title: Minimal quasi-complete intersection ideals
sources.locator: Proposition 1.9, printed page 6, PDF viewer page 6
sources.necessary_direction: For a regular local Q with maximal ideal n and J contained in n squared, an exact pair in Q/J has lifts F,G whose product is not in nJ.
sources.characteristic_check: The necessary direction of Proposition 1.9 does not exclude characteristic two; the characteristic restriction in later Theorem 5.1 is not used.
sources.role: External theorem only in the alternative algebraic argument; not a dependency of the complete general Lean proof. Background source outside the dissertation-author article inventory.
